messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8421 fired: kubelet_notready on 6 nodes in prod-us-west-2a (node group: gpu-pool-7). Auto-escalation to oncall-rotation — page sent. Impact heuristic: failed pods > 200, some dedicated tenants affected.

pagerduty: Alert details: PD-8421 | kubelet_notready | affected_nodes=[gpu-7a-03,gpu-7a-04,gpu-7a-06,gpu-7a-08,gpu-7a-09,gpu-7a-11] | severity=high | action=escalate if unacked > 2m

sara-m: Acked. Looking. quick check: are these nodes showing kernel oops or kubelet OOM?

diego: I see kubelet not ready + NodeHeartBeatMissing on `gpu-7a-03` and `gpu-7a-04` from metrics. Other nodes show `KubeletStarted` but `Ready=False`. Might be network overlay or underlying host reboot.

nisha: Sara, I’m on serial console for gpu-7a-03 now. IPMI serial shows repeated `kernel: BUG: soft lockup` and then ipmi disconnects.

ops-hardware: Noted — we've got a maintenance window scheduled later but that's unrelated. Can you confirm PDUs for rack 7A? I'll pull BMS/PDUs.

ryan: Copy. If host kernel is soft lockup across multiple nodes same rack, could be PDUs or rack-level switch. I'll check SNMP alerts.

sara-m: Team — quick customer impact check: ask routing and dedicated capacity. Diego: can you query which tenants had active dedicated workloads on affected nodes?

diego: Running query... `SELECT tenant_id FROM reserved_allocs WHERE node like 'gpu-7a-%' AND active=true` -> returns tenant_foo, tenant_bar, tenant_analytics. Initial sfx shows some 502s from tenant_analytics.

oncall-2nd: I'm taking backup: will start draining healthy nodes to move critical pods. Add a canary reroute rule so customer-facing requests avoid that rack.

sara-m: Good. Steps: 1) isolate rack -> remove from loadbalancer; 2) cordon & drain surviving nodes in the rack where possible; 3) notify sales/CS for tenant impact. Any objections?

diego: No objections. Starting cordon on nodes that are `Ready=True` but in same rack to avoid scheduling new pods there.

Messages: (command run)
```
kubectl get nodes -l topology.kubernetes.io/zone=us-west-2a -o wide | egrep 'gpu-7a|NotReady'
NAME         STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION   INTERNAL-IP
gpu-7a-03    NotReady   <none>   312d v1.25.6   10.10.7.103
gpu-7a-04    NotReady   <none>   130d v1.25.6   10.10.7.104
gpu-7a-06    NotReady   <none>    22d v1.25.6   10.10.7.106
gpu-7a-08    Ready      <none>  102d v1.25.6   10.10.7.108
gpu-7a-09    NotReady   <none>   76d v1.25.6   10.10.7.109
gpu-7a-11    Ready      <none>   11d v1.25.6   10.10.7.111
```

incident-bot: Automated remediation suggestions: try `ipmitool chassis status` on affected hosts and check rack-level BMS. If serial lost, escalate to ops-hardware.

sara-m: Nisha, can you post the ipmitool output for gpu-7a-03?

nisha: On it.

```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.10.7.101 -U admin -P **** chassis status
System Power State         : on
Power Overload             : false
Last Power Event Cause     : PWR_BTTN
```
Serial logs show repeated kernel stack traces ending with `BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 23s`. After trace, host reboots.

ops-hardware: PDU telemetry shows a brief power glitch at 02:13 UTC on PDU-7A-A feeding rack 7A. Two outlets reported brownout then recovered. This aligns with soft lockups leading to reboots.

ryan: So likely root cause is PDU/UPS transient spike. We should isolate rack and treat nodes as hardware-failed until hardware confirms.

sara-m: Agreed. Action items: (1) Oncall -> cordon/drain remaining nodes in rack (2) Ops-hardware -> schedule immediate rack inspection and replace/validate PDU A (3) Eng-platform -> ensure canary routing avoiding rack and enable autoscaling to cover capacity gap (4) CS notify for tenant_analytics degraded.

eng-platform: I'll flip Canary rule in LB and trigger cluster-autoscaler to spin fallback nodes in us-west-2b. Doing: `kubectl label node gpu-7a-08 quarantine=true` then scale up fallback pool.

diego: Started pod evictions on surviving nodes. No eviction failures yet. Some batch jobs will be rescheduled and delayed.

nisha: I engaged ops-hardware oncall via phone; they acknowledged and are onsite with the rack. PDUs will be swapped if hardware confirms.

oncall-2nd: PD-8421 set to acknowledged by Sara-M. If new nodes flip to NotReady we escalate to SEV2. Current mitigations keep P95 latency stable so user-facing impact reduced.

pagerduty: PD-8421 status updated: acknowledged at 1729001310 by sara-m. Escalation timer paused.

ops-hardware: Onsite confirms PDU-A has flaky outlet 6. They've moved outlets to PDU-B and monitoring looks stable for last 90s. Running burn-in on those hosts.

sara-m: Good. Leave nodes cordoned until hardware gives green. We'll uncordon in controlled rollout: enable one node at a time, monitor kubelet, then uncordon.

ryan: I'll also open a bug to track: `HW-2026-118` with root cause tagging PDU brownout and include telemetry and a corrective CAPA to replace aging PDU fleet in that cluster.

diego: Customer/tenant update draft for CS: "We experienced a transient rack-level power event in us-west-2a impacting dedicated GPU nodes. Most services were auto-rerouted; a small number of tenant jobs were delayed. Hardware team is on-site and we've swapped the PDU. We're running a controlled node reintroduction." Approve?

sara-m: Approve. Send via CS. Add note: outage window ~02:12-02:28 UTC, affected tenants: tenant_analytics (partial), tenant_bar (delayed batch).

oncall-2nd: Handoff: I'll take notes and watchlist until 1729001654 then hand to morning rotation. Final checks: verify all affected nodes stable and uncordoned or deallocated.

incident-bot: PD-8421 resolved? false. Monitoring escalation windows continue.

sara-m: Marking this as in mitigation. Leaving PD open until all six nodes pass health checks and are uncordoned. If any regressions happen, re-escalate to SEV2.

ops-hardware: Confirmed: smoke test passed after PDU swap; replacement part ordered for long term. We'll post the hardware ticket in ops-hardware.

ryan: Created HW ticket HW-2026-118 and linked PD-8421.

pagerduty: PD-8421 note appended: root_cause=PDU_brownout; mitigation=swapped outlets to PDU-B; status=acknowledged.

sara-m: Thanks everyone. Handoff to morning: @oncall-2nd please run the uncordon rollout per runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/cordon-uncordon-rollback and post final status here when complete.

oncall-2nd: Copy. Will do and update. :white_check_mark:
